initialExam.title: Indian Coast Guard Navik/Yantrik 2026
initialExam.description: Indian Coast Guard recruitment for Navik (General Duty & Domestic Branch) and Yantrik positions.
initialExam.qualifications: 10th pass for Navik DB, 12th with PCM for Navik GD, Diploma for Yantrik
initialExam.syllabus: Navik GD: Maths, Science, English, Reasoning, GK. Navik DB: Quant, Reasoning, English, GK. Yantrik: Maths, Science, English, GK.
initialExam.examPattern: Stage-I: Online exam. Stage-II: Physical Fitness Test. Stage-III: Document Verification & Medical.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Exam → PFT → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Navik (GD/DB) and Yantrik in Indian Coast Guard
initialExam.careerGrowth: Navik → Uttam Navik → Pradhan Navik → Adhikari.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindiancoastguard.cdac.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Appear for exam
initialExam.perks: Free food, Accommodation, Medical, Uniform, Ration
